jobs.title: TEMP - Implementation Consultant I - Payroll
jobs.description:
At Paylocity, we create software that makes companies – especially their HR teams – better, faster, and stronger. We give clients the tools they need to make their companies run, and give our employees a rewarding company culture – all putting us in a category of our own. Join us and learn what makes us unique!


We’re a fast\-growing company ready to revolutionize the payroll and HR world for hundreds of thousands of businesses by delivering innovative technology and support. We seek the best and brightest to help us create the future of our talent solutions – enabling our customers to better develop their employees. Our own employees are equally important to us: We work hard to provide the best work environment for our employees, and are dedicated to giving back to the communities in which we live and work.


We are looking for a Payroll Consultant with customer service experience and technical skills to assist new clients’ transition to their new payroll and human resources provider, Paylocity. If you are someone with computer skills, strong attention to detail, has mastered multitasking, and provides exceptional customer service, this is the right entry level opportunity for you.

**In\-Office:** **This is a 100% in\-office role based at our Meridian, ID location**. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position. Candidates must be able to work on\-site five days per week during designated work hours.

**Position Overview**  

As an Implementation Consultant I, you will support small business clients by configuring solutions that meet their unique needs. You’ll begin by conducting a detailed needs analysis, then tailor system setups to improve efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance reporting capabilities. You’ll also ensure accurate data conversion from previous systems, validate results with clients, and provide hands\-on support through the transition to our Client Services team. This role is ideal for detail\-oriented professionals who are passionate about delivering excellent client experiences and developing foundational implementation skills.

**Location:** Meridian, ID

**TEMP ROLE: 4 month contract**

**Primary Responsibilities**


The below represents the primary duties of the position, others may be assigned as needed. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Act as our clients trusted advisor, ensuring exceptional customer experiences throughout the implementation process. To include but not limited to, facilitating meetings, and maintaining communication throughout the life cycle of their implementation.
* Provide a smooth transition and post\-implementation support as needed, including system maintenance, and issue resolution, based on client feedback.
* Assist clients in data migration, data mapping, and data validation processes to ensure accurate and complete data integration into the HCM software.
* Collaborate with clients to gather and analyze their business requirements related to the
* specific HCM function (e.g., payroll, HR, time, and labor).
* Review, with client, configuration of system to ensure the software is aligned with the clients' needs and expectations to ensure optimal utilization of system capabilities.
* Collaborate with internal cross\-functional teams, including sales, product SMEs and project managers, to deliver high\-quality implementations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve implementation related matters, escalating critical concerns to the appropriate teams when necessary.

**Education and Experience**

* 1\+ years of Customer Service or Customer interfacing role
* 1\+ years of HCM implementation experience preferred
* Bachelor’s degree is strongly preferred; however, candidates with an associate degree and relevant experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent with at least five (5\) years of experience in HCM, will also be considered.
* Client Centric Approach: Possess excellent interpersonal verbal and written communication skills with a strong customer\-focused mindset throughout the implementation process.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (with a strong emphasis on Excel) and Other Programs:
* Adapt quickly to new software platforms and leverage their capabilities to optimize project outcomes. Experience with Excel functions including VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, data manipulation and analysis.
* Resourcefulness: Utilize your problem\-solving abilities to overcome obstacles and find creative solutions that meeting project requirements and client expectations.
* Project Management: Successfully handle multiple projects concurrently, effectively prioritizing tasks, managing timelines and ensuring deliverables are met on time. Maintain a high\-level of organization and attention to detail through the implementation process to
* Meet client deadlines and achieve successful outcomes.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods: The role requires sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods, typically 7\-8 hours a day.
* Use of computer and phone systems: The employee must be able to operate a computer, use phone systems, and type. This includes using multiple software programs and inquiries simultaneously

**Paylocity is an equal\-opportunity employer.** Paylocity is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. At Paylocity, we believe diversity makes us better.


We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences in age, culture, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion or spiritual belief, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We actively cultivate these differences through our employee resource groups (ERGs), employee experiences, perspectives, talents, and approaches to drive innovation in the software and services we provide our customers.


We comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. To request reasonable accommodation in the job application or interview process, please contact accessibility@paylocity.com. This email address is exclusively designated for such requests, aligning with federal and state disability laws. Please do not send resumes to this email address, as they will be removed.


The pay for this position is $25/hour; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position offers a full range of benefits outlined here. This information is provided per the relevant state and local pay transparency laws for the location in which this position will be performed. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via www.paylocity.com/careers.

jobs.description:

Regular Full Time

Description
**Welcome to Goodwill!**
Goodwill of Central North Carolina’s mission is to improve lives and enrich communities through the power of work! Thanks to our Retail Stores and Donation Centers, we break down the barriers to employment and help people achieve their job and career goals through training, support, and career readiness resources. Our values are the backbone of our diverse and inclusive organization.


*If you want to be part of a team that makes a difference – Goodwill is for you!*


**What You’ll Do:**


* The **Retail Training Specialist** provides individual and small group training to a diverse employee population. This requires the ability to develop curriculum and training plans, and facilitate coaching and training in a variety of settings.
* Provide operational training to new hire personnel, including orientation and onboarding, and other assigned team members in accordance with established guidelines in standard operating procedures.
* Responsible for creating a motivating learning environment, assessing and tracking student progress and modifying approach/supports as needed for successful skill mastery.
* Support progress on team member development plans and actively coordinates training opportunities for individuals’ improved performance and career development.
* Schedule and coordinate continued training and mentoring for personnel, providing continued support and guidance to trainees, managers, and mentors.
* Regularly travel to sites to coach trainees on assigned tasks and training curriculum.
* Stay current on all business updates; policy changes, software updates, price changes, procedural updates and changes, production quota updates, new forms, etc.; communicating changes and training personnel promptly and thoroughly to ensure seamless transitions and full understanding throughout the team.
* Utilize recommendations and observations from customer/donor surveys, assessments, floor walks, audits and secret shops to prioritize site needs, further develop individual and team members skills and enhance the retail experience for all stakeholders.

* 

**Education, Experience, and Skills that are a must:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in retail settings, preferably in management roles. Strong knowledge of retail practices, inventory control, and exceptional customer service skills required.
* Minimum of 2 years of formal experience in training and/or instruction, including the development and delivery of training curriculum to diverse populations.
* Must have a valid NC driver’s license, acceptable driving record, reliable personal vehicle, adequate vehicle insurance coverage, and ability to travel locally on a daily basis.
* Sufficient knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting procedures to understand sales reports incidental to store operations, processing information and merchandise through computer systems and POS register system.
* Excellent computer skills and expertise with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, \& PowerPoint).
* Comfortable and effective at handling customers and situations without input from others and in alignment with organizational mission, values, and philosophies.
* Due to the nature of the position as a front\-line trainer, successful candidates must demonstrate the ability to be creative, self\-sufficient, and proactive, with excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills; ability to work alone, multi\-task, and juggle competing priorities. Flexibility and responsiveness to frequent change is critical in this role.
* Must have a good command of written and spoken English, including good grammar (Bi\-lingual in Spanish is strongly preferred).
* Must successfully pass pre\-employment drug and background screens.

**Pay Range \& Schedule:**

* This position is hourly/non\-exempt. Wage is $19\-$20 per hour, based on qualification/experience.
* Position is full\-time. Work is generally conducted Monday\-Friday, 8:00am\-4:30pm, with regular requirements for evening and/or weekend support.
* Position is located at our Home Office in Greensboro, NC, with daily travel throughout our 5\-county service footprint including Alamance, Caswell, Guilford, Randolph, and Rockingham Counties. Minimal remote work may be available at a future date based on performance.

**Perks of the Job:**


* We provide an extensive benefits package for our team members that covers health care (medical, telehealth, dental, and vision), company paid life insurance, supplemental insurances (accident, cancer, disability, \& critical illness), legal support, ID protection, and pet insurance.
* Additionally, our financial benefits include an employee discount, paid time off (PTO), 12 paid holidays, a 401(k) plan with employer matched contributions of 100% of first 5% you contribute, quarterly performance\-based bonuses, paid training, employee referral bonuses, and an education assistance program of $4,000 annually. (Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.)

jobs.title: Manager of Strategic Commercial Readiness & Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission\-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle\-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN\-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.
  

  

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
**Job Description**
-------------------

*Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “* Keeping Our Heroes Connected *”?*

THE OPPORTUNITY


Silvus is seeking a ***Manager of Strategic Commercial Readiness \& Onboarding*** who will report to the *Senior Director of Strategic Go to Market Mentorship, Training, and On\-Boarding* on the Sales Enablement team.


In this role, you will be the operational engine driving comprehensive commercial readiness specifically tailored for our growing U.S. based sales team. Your primary mission is to ensure all newly hired U.S. sales colleagues are thoroughly trained, equipped, and prepared for high\-quality engagements with customers—encompassing both technical knowledge and total business operations proficiency. You will work collaboratively to aid in program development and take the lead in driving the execution of our onboarding and enablement initiatives across domestic regions. We are looking for an execution\-focused professional who can effectively coordinate with internal experts and content providers across engineering, sales ops, and product teams. You will be the force that keeps our training programs moving forward, ensuring our domestic team achieves absolute day\-one readiness in the field. The role requires up to 50% of travel to conduct on\-site training, attend trade shows, and support field demonstrations across the U.S.


This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.


The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

  

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES


* **U.S. Program Execution:** Drive the execution of the Go\-to\-Market (GTM) Onboarding \& Enablement Program specifically tailored for U.S. sales team members, ensuring new hires achieve full readiness across both technical solutions and internal business operations.
* **Business Operations Training:** Aid in developing and executing training modules covering internal business processes, sales operations tools, CRM workflows, and commercial best practices to ensure seamless execution in U.S. markets.
* **Collaborative Development \& Optimization:** Partner across departments (Sales, Engineering, Product, and Operations) to aid in the design, optimization, and scaling of the end\-to\-end curriculum.
* **Cross\-Functional Expert Coordination:** Manage and coordinate with internal content creators and subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure training assets—spanning technical manuals to business operations playbooks—are up\-to\-date and effective.
* **Total Readiness Governance:** Maintain a structured feedback loop and skill\-level tracking system (Skill Matrix) to proactively identify and address gaps in both technical understanding and operational compliance within the domestic team.
* **Continuous Learning Management:** Manage the operational calendar for recurring "Refresher \& Advanced Skills" training, keeping U.S. sales colleagues aligned on both new technical features and updated business processes.
* **Operational Logistics:** Orchestrate the logistics, scheduling, and resource allocation required for national training programs, ensuring seamless execution across relevant domestic time zones.
* **Field Readiness Mentoring:** Coordinate the post\-onboarding field application phase, guiding new hires as they engage with real clients to refine their skills and achieve full proficiency in the field.
* Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
* ***Travel Requirement –*** *Up to 50% of the time to conduct on\-site training, attend trade shows, and support field demonstrations across the U.S.*

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Bachelor’s degree is required.
* 4 years in Corporate Training, Instructional Design, Sales Operations, Business Enablement, or Program Management.
* Training \& Enablement Experience: 3\+ years of experience delivering training programs, driving onboarding initiatives, or managing commercial enablement platforms in a professional environment.
* Program Execution \& Delivery: Proven track record of executing structured training curricula, applying adult learning principles, and ensuring baseline readiness across diverse teams.
* Operational Coordination: Proven ability to manage cross\-functional stakeholders, coordinate with internal subject matter experts (SMEs), and organize complex program logistics (calendars, resources, tracking).
* Exceptional Communication: Strong talent for structuring information and ensuring content is highly accessible, actionable, and aligned with business operations and customer\-facing standards.
* Drive \& Initiative: High energy and a proactive mentality to independently manage schedules, track readiness benchmarks, and drive projects forward.
* **Must be a U.S. Citizen** due to clients under U.S. government contracts.
* **All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.**

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES


* Experience supporting or training remote commercial teams across multiple U.S. time zones.
* Experience developing, optimizing, or managing a Master Training Library, e\-learning modules, or interactive presentation decks.
* Experience in a hybrid technical/commercial environment (e.g., telecommunications, advanced IP networking, tactical systems, or technology manufacturing).
* Familiarity with sales methodology training, CRM workflows, and internal business operations tools.
* Military or tactical technical background (e.g., experience in training coordination, operational readiness, or instructional design).

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


* Trade shows.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:
* \- \- Lift equipment up to 50 lbs. for the set\-up of demonstrations and testing.

COMPENSATION: $90,000 \- $120,000 / annually

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.


#### **The Role**



Global Seller Onboarding Specialistsmanage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project\-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process. They’ll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square’s platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer\-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions.



A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1\) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2\) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3\) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4\) support Square’s international expansion efforts.


* "Global Seller Onboarding Specialists manage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process."
* "Looking for willingness to travel as part of the job (around 10%) and most likely majority of the onsites will be in and around New York/NY.

#### **You Will**


* Drive world\-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s sellers, ensuring accountability to go\-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.
* Cultivate strong cross\-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.
* Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success.  

Master Square’s platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject\-matter expert.
* Lead high\-impact, multi\-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.
* Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.
* Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process.

#### **You Have**


* BA/BS degree, preferably
* 2\-3 years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success.
* An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.
* Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.
* Ability to thrive within ambiguity and operate independently.
* Ability to drive and manage multiple cross\-functional initiatives simultaneously; strong time management, and excellent written \& verbal communication skills.
* Proven track record of success in delivering multiple complex projects in the technology industry while partnering with external and internal clients to attain deliverables.
* An ability to learn quickly as new products and organisational changes are released.
* Previous Project Management experience is expected.
* Experience in the POS, Payments or Tech industries is a plus.
* Experience in hardware installation and network configuration is a plus.
* Located in PST or MST time zone.


**Your typical day will include:**


* Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation.
* Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.
* Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.


**Perks**



At Square, we want you to be well and thrive. Our global benefits package includes:


* Healthcare coverage
* Retirement Plans
* Work from home flexibility
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Wellness perks
* Paid parental leave
* Paid time off
* Learning and Development resources

jobs.description:
**About the Role**



The Implementation Specialist II will manage the onboarding of customers in all segments by successfully implementing the Pushpay product suite. The right individual provides a distinctive post sale service that makes Pushpay the market leader and preferred choice for digital giving in the non\-profit space. This individual possesses a passion for customer satisfaction, obsession for accuracy, a blend of technical and customer\-interaction skills, a drive for excellence, can effectively navigate objections, and has what it takes to deliver results.

  


*Named as one of BuiltIn '****Best Places to Work****' in Seattle, Denver and Dallas for 2025; ranked number* ***10*** *by Seattle Business Magazine in the '****Washington's 100 Best Companies to Work For'*** *list in the large companies category for 2024; named as a 2025 '****Best Places to Work for Women'*** *by Best Companies Group.*

  


**Benefits and Compensation**



We have a passion for making all employees feel supported. In addition to having a genuine interest in helping you do your best work and drive your career, we offer:


* 100% employer\-paid premiums for Medical HDHP Plan, Dental, and Vision for employee
* 70% employer\-paid premiums for Medical PPO Plan for employees, and Medical, Dental, and Vision for dependents
* 401K match
* Hybrid work model \- 3 days in the COS office / 2 days remote
* Remote work for approved states
* 12 paid company holidays
* 2 paid Volunteer Time Off days
* 15 days PTO to start, increases with tenure and seniority
* Paid parental and adoption leave
* **Compensation Range:** **$67,500\-$78,489**


*Compensation ranges are determined by role and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*


**The following states are approved as remote work locations for this position: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA \- All other states are not in consideration for this role at this time.**

  


**What You'll Do**


* Project manage the onboarding and implementation of Catholic customers, manage a pipeline, and meet or exceed KPI's.
* Become an expert in the Pushpay product suite and set appropriate expectations with the customer.
* Deliver results, provide high quality customer interactions, drive product adoption, and effectively manage multiple/simultaneous implementations.
* Coordinate with Product, Service Delivery, and Customer Success teams to execute on implementation.
* Build and effectively execute account plans and strategies unique to each account.
* Regularly review assigned accounts to highlight key results, analyze metrics, demonstrate value, and emphasize the ROI, as well as, recommend process/procedure changes to better utilize Pushpay services.
* Help develop existing customer relationships with the company; in\-line with the company service process and ensure maximum customer retention is achieved.
* Maintain knowledge of market conditions and competitive activities.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual goals and provide accurate, timely reports and forecasts as needed for management.
* Receive direction from the VP, Director of Implementation, and guidance from Customer Success Team Leads.

  


**What You'll Bring**


* BA/BS Degree
* 3\+ years of working in SaaS onboarding and implementation, or as a Customer Success Manager.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to identify, critique, suggest, and implement intelligent changes to the clients and business optimization processes.
* Strong problem resolution skills \- proven ability to engage and interact with internal teams to resolve client issues.
* Desire to work in a startup environment, with proactive mindset and minimum need for supervision.
* Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce).
* Ability to prioritize and manage workload to meet deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple, concurrent client relationships.
* Well\-organized and strong work ethic.
* Ability to anticipate change and adjust priorities accordingly.
* Understanding of key drivers of success for Catholic parishes.
* Understanding of industry culture, products, and services.
* Excellent eye for detail – ability to create accurate and high quality pieces of work.

jobs.title: Healthcare Recruiter & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**CareerNation**, a national healthcare staffing firm, is seeking a **Healthcare Recruiter \& Onboarding Specialist** to join our team in a flexible, blended role.


This position combines **healthcare recruiting** with **candidate onboarding and compliance coordination**. It is ideal for someone who is organized, communicative, comfortable working independently, and interested in developing experience in healthcare staffing.

**Entry\-level candidates are welcome to apply. Prior healthcare staffing experience is not required — we will train the right person, and training is paid.**


This is a **variable\-hours position based on current business and staffing needs. Hours and weekly earnings are not guaranteed.**

**Compensation \& Expected Workload**

**Recruiting:** $20/hour

* Approximately **10–20 recruiting hours per week**, depending on business needs
* Paid for authorized recruiting hours worked

**Compliance \& Onboarding:** $25 per completed candidate case

* Paid upon completion of each assigned onboarding/compliance case (drug test, license verification, skills checklist, medical screening, etc)
* Current estimated volume is approximately **10 completed cases per week**
* Cases may include candidates placed through Medely, DNA, HWL, and other CareerNation clients/programs

**Paid training is provided.**


Work volume fluctuates based on open positions, candidate activity, client demand, and placements. **There are no guaranteed minimum hours, number of cases, or weekly earnings.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Healthcare Recruiting**

* Recruit healthcare professionals for temporary, contract, per diem, event, and other staffing opportunities
* Review applications and resumes to identify qualified candidates
* Conduct candidate screening calls and assess qualifications, experience, availability, and interest
* Discuss available assignments, schedules, compensation, and position requirements with candidates
* Source candidates through job boards, applicant databases, referrals, and other recruiting channels
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with active candidates
* Present qualified candidates for appropriate openings
* Maintain accurate candidate notes and recruiting activity
* Coordinate with management regarding priority positions and staffing needs
* Assist with job postings and candidate outreach as assigned

**Compliance \& Candidate Onboarding**


Manage assigned candidates from placement/acceptance through completion of their required onboarding and compliance process.


Responsibilities may include:

* Collecting and reviewing professional licenses, certifications, identification, immunization records, and other required documentation
* Coordinating background checks, drug screenings, TB testing, health documents, competency assessments, and other client requirements
* Assisting candidates with completion of required onboarding forms and documentation
* Tracking outstanding requirements and following up with candidates until their files are complete
* Reviewing files for completeness and accuracy before submission
* Maintaining accurate candidate compliance records and trackers
* Uploading or submitting required documentation through applicable client, MSP, VMS, or staffing platforms
* Communicating with candidates regarding missing or expiring requirements
* Escalating compliance issues, delays, or discrepancies when necessary
* Helping ensure candidates are fully cleared before their scheduled start dates

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; college education preferred but **not required**
* **Entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply**
* Recruiting, customer service, administrative, healthcare, HR, staffing, or credentialing experience is helpful but not required
* Comfortable speaking with candidates by phone, email, and text
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to follow detailed client\-specific processes
* Comfortable learning multiple online systems and staffing platforms
* Ability to manage several candidates and deadlines simultaneously
* Dependable and responsive during agreed\-upon working periods
* Able to work independently in a remote environment

**What We’re Looking For**


We’re looking for someone who can learn quickly, communicate professionally, stay organized, follow a process, and consistently follow through with candidates.


Because this position touches both sides of the staffing process, you’ll learn the full candidate lifecycle — from identifying and screening a healthcare professional through getting that individual fully compliant and ready to work.

**Schedule**

**Flexible, variable schedule based on business needs.**


Recruiting work is currently expected to average approximately **10–20 hours per week**, while onboarding volume is currently estimated at approximately **10 cases per week**. These are estimates only and may increase or decrease substantially.


There are **no guaranteed minimum hours, cases, or compensation.**

**Why Join CareerNation?**

* **Paid training**
* Entry\-level candidates welcome
* Flexible working hours
* Remote work
* Gain hands\-on healthcare recruiting and credentialing experience
* Learn the full healthcare staffing lifecycle
* Performance\-based opportunity for additional responsibility and growth

**Job Type:** Part\-time / Variable Hours  

**Location:** Remote  

**Recruiting Compensation:** $20/hour  

**Compliance/Onboarding Compensation:** $25 per completed case  

**Expected Recruiting Hours:** Approximately 10–20/week, variable  

**Estimated Compliance Volume:** Approximately 10 cases/week, variable

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist II - RCM- Salt Lake City, Utah
jobs.description:
Kipu is bettering the behavioral health landscape, helping treatment centers achieve the best outcomes and empowering patients and caregivers on every step of the recovery journey. Join us in our work to advance behavioral health care in our communities. Our innovative solutions support providers in treating addiction, eating disorders, and many other behavioral health conditions. Our EMR, CRM, and revenue cycle solutions help behavioral health facilities succeed in managing their patients' entire care journey, but it is through our people that we truly make a difference.

**Role Overview**


The Implementation Specialist II, RCM independently owns end\-to\-end implementations for behavioral health treatment centers on the Kipu RCM platform. You will lead discovery, translate billing and revenue cycle requirements into configuration decisions, train end users, and drive accountability for timelines and deliverables. This role operates with minimal oversight and contributes to team quality through mentorship and process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery \& Solution Design**

* Lead discovery conversations to identify client billing workflows, payer mix, compliance requirements, and constraints.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable RCM configuration decisions aligned with best practices.
* Challenge misaligned or risky requests respectfully, explaining tradeoffs and downstream billing impacts.

**Configuration \& Data Quality**

* Configure billing workflows, payer rules, fee schedules, and system settings accurately on the first pass.
* Troubleshoot RCM configuration issues by identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Validate billing data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before go\-live.

**Client Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver structured, goal\-oriented training that prepares clients to manage billing workflows independently.
* Equip client administrators to train their own teams on billing processes and system usage.
* Drive client accountability for tasks, timelines, and data deliverables.

**Project Delivery \& Risk Management**

* Own project documentation, ensuring records and project plans reflect reality.
* Identify risks early and document them with clear descriptions, owners, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional partners when scope, risk, or complexity warrants it.

**Go\-Live Readiness \& Adoption**

* Prepare clients for go\-live by validating that all billing readiness criteria are genuinely met.
* Support post\-go\-live adoption by tracking billing accuracy, claim submission rates, and early revenue cycle health.
* Contribute to process improvements and share learnings with peers and newer team members.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2\-4 years of experience implementing an RCM system, or a combination of RCM implementation and technical support.
* 6\+ years of revenue cycle management experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings and drive decisions.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing timelines.

**Preferred**

* Experience in behavioral health, mental health, or addiction treatment settings.
* Familiarity with EDI, ERA, clearinghouse processes, and payer enrollment workflows.
* Experience mentoring or supporting newer team members.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* Flexible paid time off.
* 11 Paid Holidays.
* Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance.
* Parental Leave.
* Pet Insurance.
* 401(K) with Company Match.

**Kipu Promise**


In an environment of rapid change, millions are struggling to cope. Kipu is here to help. Having shaped the industry for 10 years, today we focus on advancing our New Vision for the behavioral health ecosystem, evolving how it operates, interacts, communicates, and heals.


We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or disability status.
